about: Written by embedded_bedrock firmware_template_skill (bedrock_gen.py). Records the template revision and the answers this firmware was generated with, plus firmware-specific upgrade history. See AGENTS.md.
command: bedrock_gen.py new donguru --chip STM32G0B1CE --config-page --bkp-counters auto --counters --led PF1 --wire-weaver --ww-transport usb --ww-api donguru_api --ww-src ../../../wire_weaver

applied: 0.4.0: added bedrock_fw.json, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md. Answers reconstructed and verified: templates 01d6ae1..3cf6405 regenerate the initial commit 5e56fc6 byte for byte
0.3.0 cnt 0.4 syntax: cnt!/bkp_cnt! with warn/error levels in main.rs, also adc.rs and examples/blinky.rs (cnt dependency was already bumped locally in 2065c34)

README cnt_cli usage, init.rs doc comment
upgrades.notes: Built dev/release/examples; .cnt_bkp_buffer checked at 0x4000B100. Retention of BKP counters across reset not yet tested on hardware.

applied: 0.4.3: build.rs without the unused `let _ = out;` (file untouched, replaced); main.rs import order was already rustfmt-clean

0.5.0: WireWeaver over USB, set up by hand in the existing layout: API crate donguru_api in the repo root (../../donguru_api, member of the root Cargo workspace), firmware stays in fw/donguru; src/ww.rs from the template with the USB driver created in main.rs (USB in assign_resources, USB_UCPD1_2 in main's Irqs) and led_on/led_off switching the status LED via led::set instead of owning PF1
upgrades.notes: wire_weaver crates via relative path deps to ~/git/wire_weaver (not git). dev/release/examples build, fmt clean, .cnt_bkp_buffer still at 0x4000B100. USB enumeration and `ww list`/`ww introspect` not yet tested on hardware.

nuances: src/main.rs is hand-written (64 MHz PLL clock tree, assign-resources, spawned adc/button tasks): never replace it with the template's, only port individual changes (e.g. counter macros in DefaultHandler/HardFault) by hand
embassy-stm32 uses time-driver-tim4 on purpose: time-driver-any picks TIM15, which drives the PF1 LED. Keep it when Cargo.toml template changes
Local Cargo.toml additions to keep: embassy-usb, embassy-futures, [features] debug-adc/debug-button, [[bin]] test=false, defmt-rtt disable-blocking-mode
src/adc.rs, button.rs, led.rs, examples/, scripts/size.py are local-only (not from the template), but they use the cnt macros, so update them together with template counter-syntax changes

WireWeaver layout differs from the template's: the API crate is donguru_api/ in the repo root (two levels up, in the root workspace, uses workspace edition/license), the firmware is fw/donguru/ (not firmware/). When regenerating with --wire-weaver, map <out>/donguru_api -> ../../donguru_api and <out>/firmware -> . ; the generator writes absolute --ww-src paths, keep the relative ../../../wire_weaver (firmware) and ../../wire_weaver (API crate) paths

USB is set up in main.rs (UsbResources, Irqs, usb::Driver::new) and passed to ww::start; ww.rs has no bind_interrupts/usb_driver. ServerState owns no LED: PF1 is the PWM status LED owned by led::led_task, the API calls led::set
embassy-usb is a direct dependency with default-features = false (also used by examples/usb_serial.rs); wire_weaver_usb_embassy pulls its own features
